--- pipe_drop.sql
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT * FROM Singers
  |> DROP FirstName, `Last Name`,
)

--- AST

  Query: &ast.Select{
    Results: []ast.SelectItem{
      &ast.Star{
        Star: 7,
      },
    },
    From: &ast.From{
      From:   9,
      Source: &ast.SubQueryTableExpr{
        Lparen: 14,
        Rparen: 74,
        Query:  &ast.Query{
          Query: &ast.Select{
            Select:  18,
            Results: []ast.SelectItem{
              &ast.Star{
                Star: 25,
              },
            },
            From: &ast.From{
              From:   27,
              Source: &ast.TableName{
                Table: &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 32,
                  NameEnd: 39,
                  Name:    "Singers",
                },
              },
            },
          },
          PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
            &ast.PipeDrop{
              Pipe:    42,
              Columns: []*ast.Ident{
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 50,
                  NameEnd: 59,
                  Name:    "FirstName",
                },
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 61,
                  NameEnd: 72,
                  Name:    "Last Name",
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM Singers |> DROP FirstName, `Last Name`)
